name: Casa Cipriani New York
positioning: Hotel and private members club in the 1909 Battery Maritime Building on the Lower Manhattan waterfront, with interiors by Thierry Despont
best_for: Travelers who want a waterfront Lower Manhattan base steps from Wall Street and the Financial District
Guests drawn to a private-club atmosphere with a dress code and Old-World design

facts.text: The hotel sits on the water in Lower Manhattan, steps from Wall Street and the Financial District.
The building is the former Governors Island ferry terminal.
The guestrooms and suites were designed by Thierry Despont, and many have private terraces overlooking the East River, the Brooklyn Bridge and the Statue of Liberty.
The corridors have lacquered hand rails and portholes on the guestroom doors.
The vaulted porch ceiling on the street-facing side of the building still has the original Guastavino tiles.
Two Presidential Suites are customized with Loro Piana Interiors.
Before check-in, guests can choose between Italian cotton or Italian linen sheets.
Casa Cipriani Wellness features cast iron architectural details and state-of-the-art equipment.
After a workout, guests can relax in eucalyptus steam baths, cryotherapy and traditional cedar saunas.
Casa Cipriani is a private members club in lower Manhattan.
The formal restaurant's interior is inspired by the dining room of a French ocean liner of the thirties.
Guests visiting Casa Cipriani New York may enjoy a complimentary ride in the House Car.

highlights.text: Casa Cipriani is in the historic 1909 Battery Maritime Building, overlooking the Statue of Liberty and New York Harbor.
Thierry Despont wanted guests to feel like they were on a vintage luxury ocean liner.
The Roebling Presidential Suite has a wraparound terrace facing the Brooklyn Bridge, Brooklyn and the East River.
The spa's hand-picked therapists offer signature massages and treatments including acupuncture, pain management, skincare and medical stress recovery.
The Jazz Cafe offers dinner with live music, with a pianist and two different jazz bands alternating each evening.

considerations.text: A dress code applies: members and guests are asked to respect the Beaux-Arts tradition of the landmark building through appropriate attire.
After 5:00 PM children are not permitted in any areas of the 5th Floor or Rooftop.
The Wellness Center is exclusively for the Casa Cipriani community, while the Spa can be reserved by non-member guests.
